_doc: Curation knobs for vpic_pare_down.py, applied after the vehicle-type filter.
Checked in so every dataset refresh reproduces the same editorial calls; the diff report shows what changed between vintages.

motorcycle_min_models: a make whose kept-type WMIs are motorcycle-only must have at least this many models in vPIC to survive. Against the 2026-07 vintage every major manufacturer clears 25 (Harley 369, Yamaha 268, Kawasaki 218, Indian 77, Moto Guzzi 68, Ducati/KTM 61, Aprilia 54, MV Agusta 44, Husqvarna 41, Victory 35, Piaggio&Vespa 34, Zero 33, Buell 29) while the 1-24 band is ~1,550 custom shops and small importers. Mixed car+bike makes (Honda, BMW, Suzuki, Triumph) are never subject to the threshold.

force_keep_makes: exact make names (case-insensitive) kept regardless of the threshold. Seeded with real brands the 25-model bar would drop. Known borderline names left OUT of the seed, add here if wanted: CAKE, Janus, Arch Motorcycle Co, Stark Future, Royal Alloy, Genuine Scooters.
force_drop_makes: exact make names (case-insensitive) removed from any build even when the heuristics keep them. The place for odd one-off makes; cottage car manufacturers stay unless named here.
